y-m-83-07.title: Rahoto mai cewa ƙa’idar da take da mafi ƙarancin yiwuwar zaɓuɓɓuka ita ce mafi aminci
y-m-83-07.goal: Nemo kuskure a rahoto wanda ƙirgarsa daidai ne amma ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne, ƙirƙiri ƙa’idoji da suka cika sharuddan da kanka, sannan ka tantance zato da ake buƙata kafin a yi magana game da yiwuwar faruwa ta amfani da adadin zaɓuɓɓuka.
y-m-83-07.material: Muna son yanke shawara kan ƙa’idar lambar kulle na ma’ajiyar kayan kulob. Lambar tana da lambobi 4, kuma kowanne wuri yana amfani da ɗaya daga lambobi 0 zuwa 9. Ƙa’ida R1 tana barin a maimaita lamba, R2 tana buƙatar lambobi huɗun su bambanta, R3 tana barin maimaita lamba amma lambar farko ba za ta zama 0 ba. Ɗalibi ya rubuta wani ɓangaren rahoto yana kwatanta ƙa’idojin bisa ƙirga adadin lambobin da za su yiwu a kowace ƙa’ida. Ba a yanke shawarar yadda za a zaɓi lambar ba tukuna.
y-m-83-07.thinking.0: Lura cewa ƙarshe na iya zama ba daidai ba ko da lissafin daidai ne.
y-m-83-07.prereq.0: Zato game da tsarin makaranta: ana ɗaukar wannan a matsayin aikin bincike da ake yi bayan koyon ƙirga (ƙa’idar ninkawa, sauyawa jeri) da muhimman tunanin yiwuwar faruwa. “H3” lakabin matakin wahala ne kawai na rukunin ayyukan da aka samar, ba warewa ga wani aji ba.
y-m-83-07.prereq.2: Tunanin cewa idan lokuta masu yiwuwa suna da yiwuwar daidai, yiwuwar ita ce 1/(adadin lokuta)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.prompt: Wannan rahoto yana kwatanta ƙa’idojin lambar kulle ta ma’ajiyar kulob (lambobi 4) bisa adadin zaɓuɓɓuka. Zaɓi layi guda inda tunanin bai dace ba. (Lambobin layi suna farawa daga 1 a allon.)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace ƙa’ida, bayyana da kalmomi adadin lambobin da za a zaɓa daga cikinsu idan ka zaɓi lamba ɗaya sannan ka yi ƙoƙarin zato.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda yiwuwar zato take bambanta idan akwai zaɓuɓɓuka 5040 da kuma 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.0: Ƙa’ida R1 (ana iya maimaita lamba): za a iya amfani da kowace lamba 0 zuwa 9 a kowane wuri, saboda haka akwai zaɓuɓɓuka 10×10×10×10 = 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.1: Ƙa’ida R2 (duk lambobi huɗun sun bambanta): akwai zaɓi 10 na farko, 9 na biyu, 8 na uku, 7 na huɗu, saboda haka 10×9×8×7 = 5040 zaɓuɓɓuka.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.2: Ƙa’ida R3 (ana iya maimaita lamba amma wurin farko ba 0 ba ne): zaɓuɓɓuka 9 na farko, 10 ga kowanne sauran wuri, saboda haka 9×10×10×10 = 9000 zaɓuɓɓuka.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka adadin zaɓuɓɓukan shi ne R2 < R3 < R1. R2, mai ƙaramin zaɓuɓɓuka, shi ne mafi aminci.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka amfani da ƙa’idar da ba ta barin maimaita lamba yana sa lambar ta fi aminci.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.explain: Ƙirgar zaɓuɓɓuka a layuka 1 zuwa 3 (10000, 5040, 9000) daidai ce. Amma layi na 4 ya ce ƙa’idar da ke da ƙarancin zaɓuɓɓuka ita ce mafi aminci. Idan wani zai yi ƙoƙarin zato ta zaɓi, yawan yiwuwar lambobin da ake da su ne ke sa zato ya yi wahala. Layi na 5 ƙarshe ne da ya samo asali daga kuskure iri ɗaya.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, ƙirƙiri ƙa’idar kulle da kanka. Lambar sirri da za ta yiwu dole ne ta kai 1,000,000 ko fiye, amma domin ta kasance mai sauƙin tunawa tsawonta bai wuce 5 ba. Adadin nau’ikan haruffa k da za ka iya amfani da su ɗaya ne daga 10 (lambobi kawai), 26 (ƙananan haruffan Turanci kawai), 36 (lambobi da ƙananan haruffan Turanci), ko 62 (lambobi da manya da ƙananan haruffan Turanci); ana iya maimaita harafi. Nemo nau’i-nau’i (k, n) guda 3 da suka cika sharuddan.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi k da n ɗaya bayan ɗaya sannan ka lissafta adadin lambobin sirri da za su yiwu. Duba ko ga wasu k, ko n=5 ma bai isa ba.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sanya n=4 da 5, sannan ka kwatanta girman k da ake buƙata domin wuce sharadin.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c1: k ƙima ce da aka yarda da ita.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c1: k dole ne ya zama ɗaya daga 10, 26, 36, 62.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Tsawon lamba ce cikakkiya daga 1 zuwa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsawon n dole ne ya zama lamba cikakkiya daga 1 zuwa 5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Akwai lambobin sirri da za su yiwu 1,000,000 ko fiye.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Adadin lambobin sirri da za su yiwu (k ana ninkawa sau n) bai kai 1,000,000 ba.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.explain: Zaɓuɓɓukan da k^n≥1,000,000 su ne (26, 5)=11,881,376, (36, 4)=1,679,616, (36, 5), (62, 4), (62, 5). Idan lambobi kawai ake amfani da su (k=10), n=5 yana ba da zaɓuɓɓuka 100,000 kawai, don haka ana buƙatar tsawon 6; haruffan Turanci ƙanana 4 (26⁴=456,976) ma ba su isa ba.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.prompt: Kana son cewa “a ƙarƙashin ƙa’ida R1, yiwuwar zato lambar da zaɓi guda ɗaya ita ce 1/10000”. Domin wannan magana ta zama gaskiya, wane zato ake buƙata a cikin waɗannan?
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunani a rayuwa ta gaske ko za a yi amfani da kowace daga cikin lambobi 10000 masu yiwuwa adadin lokuta iri ɗaya.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo inda aka yi amfani da zato “yiwuwar daidai” a lissafin da ya ba da yiwuwar 1/10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.a: Lambar dole ne ta kasance mai sauƙin tunawa kamar 1234, kuma kada a maimaita ta.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.a: Lambobin da suke da sauƙin tunawa su ne waɗanda mutane suka fara gwadawa. Wannan na iya sa zato ya fi sauƙi.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.b: Dole ne mai ƙoƙarin zato ya riga ya gwada sau ɗaya ko biyu kuma ya gaza.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.b: Ko ya taɓa gwadawa a baya ba shi ne yiwuwar gwaji na farko ba. Ka gano abin da yiwuwar 1/10000 take wakilta.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.c: Ana zaɓar lambobi 10000 da yiwuwar daidai, kuma mai zato ya san ƙa’idar.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.c: Ka san cewa domin yiwuwar ta zama “akasin adadin zaɓuɓɓuka”, ana buƙatar zato cewa yiwuwar lokuta duk ɗaya ce.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.d: Dole ne a canza ƙa’idar zuwa irin R2 wadda ba ta barin maimaita lambobi.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.d: Wannan sharadin ba shi da alaƙa da abin da ƙa’ida R1 take. Idan ka canza R1 zuwa R2, adadin zaɓuɓɓuka da kansa zai canza.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.explain: Domin akasin adadin zaɓuɓɓuka ya zama yiwuwar faruwa, kana buƙatar zato cewa ana zaɓar lambobi masu yiwuwa da yiwuwar daidai. Idan mutane suna yawan zaɓar ranar haihuwa ko 1234, ainihin yiwuwar zato na iya fi wannan girma. Adadin zaɓuɓɓuka hujja ɗaya ce kawai ga aminci.

y-m-83-01.title: Za mu iya faɗi mako na goma daga furucin da ya dace da maki biyar?
y-m-83-01.topic: Models na Function da suka dace da bayanai da Hasashe a Wajen Zangon
y-m-83-01.goal: Bi matakan neman model quadratic da ya dace da bayanai, sake duba hasashe da tabbaci yayin da sabon bayani ke zuwa, sannan faɗi zangon da za a iya amincewa da model.
y-m-83-01.material: Ƙungiyar kimiyya tana shuka wake kidney ɗaya a cikin tukunya ta cikin gida. A rana ɗaya ta mako kuma lokaci ɗaya, suna auna tsayin ƙashin shukar da ruler zuwa cm mafi kusa, sannan suna ba ta ruwa da haske iri ɗaya kowane mako. Ana bayyana bayanai mataki-mataki, kuma a kowane mataki za ka yanke yadda za a bayyana tsayi bayan mako na 5.
y-m-83-01.thinking.0: Zaɓar model bisa yadda ƙaruwa ke canzawa
y-m-83-01.thinking.1: Daidaita hasashe da tabbaci da sabon bayani
y-m-83-01.thinking.2: Bambance zangon da model ya dace da iyakokin gaskiya
y-m-83-01.prereq.0: Zaton tsarin makaranta: ana ganin wannan a matsayin aikin bincike da ake yi bayan koyon darasin functions (linear da quadratic). 'H3' lakabin wahalar wannan rukuni ne kawai, ba yana nufin darasi ya dace da wani aji ba.
y-m-83-01.prereq.1: Nemo da kwatanta canje-canje (ƙaruwa) daga ƙimomin jadawali
y-m-83-01.prereq.2: Nemo ƙimomin furucin function linear da quadratic
y-m-83-01.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanan tsayin shukar wake da aka auna mako-mako ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane lokaci bayan an bayyana sabo, zaɓi tunaninka game da tsayin mako na 5 (daga baya mako na 10 ma), sannan ka sake duba tunaninka yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa. Riƙe tunanin farko ma ya dace idan kana da shaida.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.hint.0: Idan sabon bayani ya fito, da farko kwatanta yadda hasashenka ya bambanta da wannan ƙima.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ƙarin tsayi na kowane mako gefe da gefe, sannan ka duba yadda ƙarin kansa yake canzawa.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Ƙungiyar kimiyya tana shuka wake kidney ɗaya a cikin tukunya ta cikin gida. A rana ɗaya ta mako kuma lokaci ɗaya, suna auna tsayin ƙashin shukar da ruler zuwa cm mafi kusa, sannan suna ba ta ruwa da haske iri ɗaya kowane mako. Ƙimomin da aka auna su ne 4cm a mako na 1, 7cm a mako na 2, da 12cm a mako na 3.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Dole ne ka yi hasashen tsayi a mako na 5. Da bayanan da ake da su yanzu kawai, wace magana ce ta fi dacewa?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Da maki uku kawai, models daban-daban na iya dacewa da bayanai. Abin lura shi ne ƙarin da ya canza daga 3 zuwa 5 yana sa a yi shakku kan zato cewa 'yana girma da tsayi iri ɗaya kowace mako'.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ƙarin ya canza zuwa 3 cm da 5 cm, saboda haka kada ka ƙayyade ƙima guda; bayyana zangon bisa zato.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka duba gaskiyar cewa shaida (bayanai) har yanzu kaɗan ce tare da gaskiyar cewa ƙarin ya canza, sannan ka raba hasashen bisa zato.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ya girma 8cm daga farkon 4cm zuwa 12cm a mako na 3, saboda haka ina zaton yana girma 4cm kowane mako kuma ina hasashen 20cm a mako na 5.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka taƙaita bayanai da matsakaicin ƙarin guda ɗaya. Amma ainihin ƙarin ya canza daga 3cm zuwa 5cm. Ka fara gwada zato cewa 'iri ɗaya ne kowane mako'?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ƙarin ya karu da 2 daga 3 zuwa 5, saboda haka ina zaton +7 a mako na 4 da +9 a mako na 5, in yi hasashen 28cm, sannan in ce zan ƙara auna domin dubawa.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka karanta canjin ƙarin a matsayin ƙa'ida sannan ka bayyana wannan ƙa'ida a matsayin 'zato'. Ka kuma ce maki uku kaɗai na buƙatar ƙarin dubawa.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Na auna sau uku kawai, saboda haka ina ganin abin da ya dace shi ne kada a faɗi wata lamba ko kaɗan game da mako na 5.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Yana da kyau a yi taka-tsantsan idan bayanai kaɗan ne. Amma 'bayyana zato sannan a ba da zangon ƙima' ya bambanta da 'kada a faɗi komai'.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ƙimar da aka auna a mako na 4 ita ce 19cm. Zuwa yanzu, makonni 1 zuwa 4 sun ba da 4, 7, 12, 19cm.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sake bayyana hasashenka na mako na 5 tare da ƙimar mako na 4.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan ƙarin ya ci gaba da ƙaruwa da 2 zuwa 3, 5, 7, tsayin mako n ya yi daidai da quadratic mai siffar n²+3 (cm) ga duk ƙimomin makonni 1 zuwa 4. Wannan furuci yana ba da 28cm a mako na 5. Amma 'furucin ya dace da maki huɗu' da 'furucin zai ci gaba da dacewa a nan gaba' abubuwa ne daban.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ina riƙe hasashen 20cm na mako na 5 da na yanke bisa bayanan har zuwa mako na 3, kuma ba zan canza shi ba.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mako na 4 ya riga ya kai 19cm, saboda haka idan mako na 5 ya zama 20cm, yana nufin ya ƙaru 1cm kawai cikin mako. Ka duba ko hakan ya danganta da ƙarin baya na 3, 5, 7?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Matsakaicin ƙarin ƙimomin huɗu 5cm ne, saboda haka zan yi amfani da shi yadda yake in yi hasashen 24cm a mako na 5.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Matsakaicin ƙarin yana goge tsarin ci gaba da ƙarin 3, 5, 7. Kafin mayar da shi matsakaici, duba yadda ƙarin ke gudana.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ƙarin ya ƙaru da 2cm kowane mako kamar 3, 5, 7, saboda haka ina ganin mako na 5 zai kai kusan 19+9=28cm.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka gano ƙa'idar da ke ci gaba da canjin ƙarin sannan ka yi amfani da ita wajen hasashen.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ƙa'idar ƙarin tana kama da daidai, amma maki huɗu ne kawai, saboda haka zan ce kusan 28cm kuma in ce zan duba ta da ma'aunin mako na 5.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yayin da kake amfani da ƙa'idar wajen hasashe, ka ware ɓangaren da ba a tabbatar ba.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ƙimar da aka auna a mako na 5 ita ce 28cm, daidai da hasashen, mako na 6 kuma 36cm ne. Saka n=6 cikin furucin n²+3 yana ba da 39cm. Bayanin wannan nau'in ya ce, 'Ƙashin shukar yana daina girma a kusan 60cm.'
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Za mu iya amfani da wannan furuci domin yin hasashen har mako na 10 (ƙimar furucin 103cm) a rahoto? Zaɓi tunaninka, la'akari da duk bayanan zuwa yanzu da bayanin.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Ko da furucin ya dace da maki 5, idan ƙimar da aka auna sabuwa ta ɗan bambanta kuma akwai iyaka a zahiri (60cm), hasashen da aka shimfiɗa wajen zangon ya zama marar ƙarfi. A gefe guda, har yanzu babu dalilin watsar da furucin gaba ɗaya.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Dole 36cm na mako na 6 kuskuren ma'auni ne, saboda haka zan yi watsi da shi, in rubuta 103cm na mako na 10 daga furucin a rahoto yadda yake.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan ka kira bayanai guda ɗaya da bai dace ba kuskure, furucin kullum zai zama daidai. Ka gano ko bambancin 3cm saboda kuskure ne ko kuwa ƙarin ya fara raguwa?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yi amfani da wannan dabara cikin ma'aunin makonni 1 zuwa 6 kawai, sannan ka rubuta cewa yana da wuya a amince da ƙimar mako na 10 saboda iyakar 60 cm da bambancin mako na 6.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana bayyana zangon da model ya dace da bayanai da zangon da aka shimfiɗa shi wajen su dabam-dabam.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Furucin bai dace da ƙimar mako na 6 ba, saboda haka zan yar da quadratic ɗin in sake nemo furucin linear daga farko.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Saboda aya guda ba ta dace ba, kana yar da model gaba ɗaya wanda ya dace da maki 5 sosai. Ka tsara yadda ya yi daidai da inda ya fara karkacewa?
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kada ka yanke hukunci daga aya guda ta mako na 6; auna makonni 7 da 8 ma kafin yanke hukunci, sannan ka bayyana cewa ƙimar mako na 10 ƙimar dabarar ce kawai.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka dakata da yanke hukunci amma ka bayyana a sarari abin da kake buƙatar ƙarin sani.
y-m-83-01.s.s1.reflect: Da farko yana da wuya a ƙayyade ƙima guda, bayanai suka ƙaru sai ka saita ƙa'ida a matsayin zato. A ƙarshe, ka raba 'zangon da furucin ya dace' da 'ƙimomin da aka shimfiɗa bayan furucin'? Idan tunaninka ya canza, faɗi abin da ya jawo; idan bai canza ba, faɗi shaidar da ka dogara da ita.
y-m-83-01.s.s2.prompt: Domin hasashen mako na 10 ya zama abin dogaro, wane ƙarin bayani kake buƙatar sani daga cikin waɗannan? Zaɓi duk abin da ake buƙata.
y-m-83-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta layi ɗaya cewa "idan na sami wannan bayani, me zai canza yayin da nake magana game da ƙimar mako na 10?"
y-m-83-01.s.s2.hint.1: Lokacin da furuci da ƙimar da aka auna suka saɓa a mako na 6, kwatanta wane bayani zai taimaka wajen tsara dalilin.

y-m-83-02.title: Maki 100 za su iya bambance 3.12 da 3.14?
y-m-83-02.topic: Ƙiyasta Ƙima da Kwaikwayo, da Kuskure
y-m-83-02.goal: A rahoton da ya ƙiyasta π ta hanyar sanya maki bazuwar, nemo inda aka yi ikirari da tabbaci fiye da hujja, bayyana iyakar ƙarshe bisa yadda maimaita sakamako ya watse, sannan ka tsara gwaji mafi dogaro da kanka.
y-m-83-02.material: Muna son ƙiyasta ƙimar pi (π) ta kwaikwayo. A kan jirgin coordinate, kwamfuta tana sanya maki bazuwar daidai a cikin murabba'i inda 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 da 0 ≤ y ≤ 1 (gefe 1). Idan x² + y² < 1 (x squared da y squared sun yi ƙasa da 1), maki yana cikin kwata da'ira mai radius 1. Filin kwata da'ira π/4 ne, filin murabba'i kuma 1 ne, saboda haka yiwuwar maki ya faɗa cikin kwata da'ira ita ce π/4. Wata ƙungiya ta sanya maki 100 sannan ta rubuta rahoto.

y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.1: Idan ka sake yin wannan gwajin, ka yi tunanin ko 78 zai sake fitowa daidai.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.0: An sanya maki 100 bazuwar a cikin murabba'in.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.1: Cikinsu, maki masu x² + y² < 1, wato maki da ke cikin kwata da'ira, sun kai 78.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.2: Yiwuwar maki ya faɗa cikin kwata da'ira ita ce rabon filin π/4, saboda haka za mu iya cewa 78/100 ≈ π/4.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka π=3.12, kuma wannan ya yi ƙasa da 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.5: Idan muka ƙara maki zuwa 1000, sakamakon tabbas zai kusanci 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 5 ya bayyana ƙiyasin 3.12 daga maki 100 kamar ƙimar π ta gaskiya, layi na 6 kuma ya ce ƙara maki 'tabbas' zai kusantar da sakamako. Gwajin bazuwar yana ba da sakamako daban ko da an sake yin shi ta hanya ɗaya; da ƙarin maki yaɗuwar tana raguwa gabaɗaya, amma babu garanti cewa sakamako guda zai fi kusanci. Matakan layuka 1 zuwa 4 (rabo → π/4 → ninka sau 4) za a iya amfani da su yadda suke.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙungiyoyi 5 kowacce sun sanya maki 100 ta hanya ɗaya, sun ƙirga maki a cikin kwata da'ira, suka samu 78, 81, 74, 80, da 77. Ƙiyasin 4×(adadin maki)/100 su ne 3.12, 3.24, 2.96, 3.20, da 3.08, matsakaicin kuma 3.12 ne. Yaya kake fahimtar furucin 'wannan gwajin yana gaya mana cewa π ya yi ƙasa da 3.14'?

y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka wannan bambanci kusa da bambanci tsakanin 3.14 da 3.12, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.a: 3.12 ce ta fi kusantar 3.14, saboda haka ƙungiyar da ta samu wannan ƙima ta yi gwajin da daidaito mafi girma.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ba ya bambance sakamako guda da ya kusanto bisa sa'a da kuma hanya mai daidaito. Duba yadda ƙimomi suka watse lokacin da aka maimaita hanya ɗaya.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.b: Matsakaicin sakamako biyar 3.12 ne, saboda haka za mu iya yanke hukuncin cewa π=3.12 kuma ya yi ƙasa da 3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.b: Ɗaukar matsakaici yana rage yaɗuwa, amma maki 500 har yanzu ba su isa su bambance bambancin 0.02 tsakanin 3.12 da 3.14 ba. Ka gano irin tabbacin da matsakaicin zai iya bayarwa.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.c: Sakamako sun watse daga 2.96 zuwa 3.24, saboda haka da maki 100 ba za ka iya cewa komai kan bambancin 3.12 da 3.14 ba.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.c: Ka kwatanta yaɗuwar sakamakon maimaituwa (0.28) da bambancin da kake son ganowa (0.02), ka ga cewa yaɗuwar ta fi girma sosai.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.d: Sakamakon kowace ƙungiya ya bambanta, saboda haka wannan gwajin ba zai iya gaya mana komai game da π ba.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.d: Ka fassara bambancin sakamako a matsayin gwajin ba shi da amfani. Idan ka san girman yaɗuwar, har yanzu za ka iya cewa π kusan 3 ne.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.explain: Sakamako biyar suna tsakanin 2.96 da 3.24, sun watse da kusan 0.28. Bambancin da muke son ganowa, 0.02, ya fi wannan yaɗuwa ƙanƙanta sosai. Saboda haka wannan gwajin ba zai iya cewa wanne ne daidai, 3.12 ko 3.14, ba, kuma zai iya cewa π kusan 3 ne kawai.

y-m-83-04.topic: Kwatanta ta hanyar Raba zuwa Rukuni (Fassarar Bayanai)
y-m-83-04.goal: Idan rabon haɗaka da rabon na'ura suka nuna kwatance daban-daban, bincika ko sharuɗɗan kwatanci iri ɗaya ne, daidaita hukunci da tabbaci, sannan ka bayyana dalili da lambobi.
y-m-83-04.material: Manhajar ɗakin karatu ta wata makaranta ta nuna jimlolin shawarwari A da B a madadin juna sannan ta rubuta dannawa. Manhajar ce ta yanke wa masu amfani da wace na'ura (wayar hannu ko PC) za a nuna jimlar, ba ɗalibai suka saita bazuwar ba. Ana bayyana bayanan mataki ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kuma a kowane mataki kana yanke hukunci kan wace jimla ce ke samun dannawa da yawa.

y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 32 na A ya yi ƙasa da 58 na B, saboda haka ba za mu ce A ta fi samun dannawa ba, amma kuma ba mu yanke wacce ta fi ba.
y-m-83-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ko da sakamakon ya bambanta, ka dakata da hukunci. Ka faɗi dalilin dakatarwa.

y-m-83-05.title: Za a iya cewa haɗa riba kowace wata 0.5×12 ita ce 6% a shekara?
y-m-83-05.topic: Kwatanta tsarin ruwa da yanke hukunci kan bayanin da ake buƙata
y-m-83-05.goal: Gwada da lambobi da’awar da ke kwatanta ruwa mai taruwa kowane wata da ruwa mai sauƙi na shekara, tantance irin bayanin da ake buƙata domin yanke hukunci, sannan ka nemo ka bayyana yadda bambancin ke canzawa bisa tsawon lokaci.
y-m-83-05.material: Wani ɗalibi ya ga tallan banki ya ce, “Ajiya mai riba mai taruwa da ke ƙara ruwa 0.5% kowane wata ita ce 0.5×12=6, saboda haka daidai take da ajiya mai ruwa mai sauƙi 6% a shekara.” Ga compound interest, ana ƙara ribar kowane wata ga babban kuɗi domin lissafa ribar wata mai zuwa; ga simple interest, ana lissafa ruwa ne bisa babban kuɗin asali kawai. A wannan aiki a ɗauka babu haraji ko kuɗin hidima.
